name: [Equip] The API answered 5xx
query: logs("service:equip-backend source:vercel \"[INFO] api:\" (\" 500 \" OR \" 502 \" OR \" 503 \" OR \" 504 \")").index("*").rollup("count").last("10m") >= 3
message:
Our API answered 5xx three or more times in ten minutes (none in the 15 days before this monitor was made, 25.11.2026).

The error-spike monitor (19730778) watches the backend's own ERROR records; this one watches what people actually received, including 503s the code returns on purpose (database or a provider unavailable) without logging an error. Vercel's own failures (timeouts, crashes) are 22874850.

Notify: @supportequip@gmail.com
